Title: Autoryzacja - login page (page layout)
Preconditions: User has an account created in Omnetic (valid e-mail and password)

Step:
Verify elements in page layout:
- 'Login' field
- 'Hasło' field
- 'Zaloguj' button
- 'Zapomniałeś hasła?' link
Expected result: All elements are visible and correctly labelled.

Title: Autoryzacja - login (invalid credentials)
Preconditions: User has an account created in Omnetic (valid e-mail and password)

Step: Fill in field 'Login' with a valid e-mail and field 'Hasło' with an incorrect password

Expected result: Error message appears: 'Błędny login lub hasło'
